status: Authoring only; no compilation, component execution, production/old source/input edits, hashes or Git.
basis: Reuse actual initialization/Component/typed ownership copies from the reviewed upl_cubic_cpu_wall_r1.cpp. The actual chosen W/C input and its real CSP constants select the kernel; separate genuine seed invocations are required. No runtime re-labelling of a Cubic seed as Wendland.
initialization: Original zero-g equal-dp parallel mDBC global FreeSlip seed, 1024 soil+256 fixed native IDs, h/dp1.8, Z-periodic. InitRunCpu retains its real FreeSlip admission. A further explicit InitDynamicPoreWallCpu is made with global FreeSlip and null overrides; only afterward does the private fixture temporarily select NoSlip. Public initialization guards are not removed.
conditions: Per kernel invocation: globalFree/null overrides, globalNoSlip/null overrides, globalFree with left NoSlip/right FreeSlip local override; each coincident and exact dp/8 mirror target offset. Six cases, 1536 wall rows (768 NoSlip+768 FreeSlip), 768 off-grid targets. Two kernel invocations together would be 12 cases; no such execution result is asserted.
borrowed_mode_lifetime: A test-local vector<byte>(Np) backs the temporary per-particle selector including periodic fixed copies. Existing member BoundSlipModec is borrowed, never allocated/replaced as production-owned state. A small reference-based scope guard restores original pointer and SlipMode before the vector/base destruction, including an exception; each component also checks selector bytes unchanged.
fields: J=1+x/1024 and p=128+256x retain mirror scalar policy at zero gravity. All XYZ manufactured mirror velocity components are nonzero, only for zero-step vector transfer; this is not a 3D or physical antiplane claim. All six stress components are affine in x. NS expects sigma at actual boundary B without sign reflection, FS expects mirror QsigmaQ. Affine xz shear 8+32x has a nonzero constant level and slope; the test distinguishes wrong FreeSlip sign and omitted mirror-to-B extrapolation by >100 times the unchanged stress roundoff budget. This is one combined affine xz field, not a separate pure-constant stress-only experiment.
separation: Full derivative image=-v_mirror for NS and Qv_mirror for FS. Viscous tangent expectation is Pt of that image, separately checked against actual TangenVel; physical fixed velocity remains exactly zero. Full nine-component C has geometric QCQ and all XYZ Darcy Ace has geometric QA at zero g for BOTH slips. Nonzero tangent Ace therefore detects accidental reuse of the NS full velocity sign. These are reconstruction checks, not a force-stage or Darcy PDE proof.
budgets: Retained condition max(1,||M||inf*||M^-1||inf) using selected W/C/J-weighted support, td=32768 DBL_EPSILON condition, tf=64 FLT_EPSILON condition. J<=2td, p<=256tf, derivative/tangent/Ace vector errors<=tf, six-stress max error<=128td, nine-C max error<=4td. Native physical26 and native C/Ace must be byte-unchanged by wall stages; original native fields and all geometry/IDs/normals restored afterward.
output: Fresh result with six per-case CSVs, native_ids.csv, fixed_ids.csv, Run.out and completion.json. CLI: helper.exe --wall -cpu -ompthreads:1 -stable -mdbc_freeslip ABS_ZERO_G_W_OR_CUBIC_SEED ABS_FRESH_RESULT. Root full-read precedes linking against the current source-frozen CPU Debug non-main objects. No old wrapper or automatic retry.
limits: No force kernel, wall reaction, SH reflection, integrator, public NoSlip scope change, mixed-axis corner, inactive wall, evolving J/k, normal-gravity extension, plasticity or physical acceptance. The stress extrapolation follows the retained legacy policy with current double anchored fitting, not an exact clone of legacy float/zeroth-order interpolation or a tensor-reflection theorem.
